title: Narrator clip: the channeler's second trance in front of Friend

tellings.quote: He sat for several minutes and then appeared in a deep trance with his Adam's apple moving up and down rapidly.

plain: In 1959 in Washington, D.C., a channeler, a person said to pass on messages from other beings while in a trance, went into a second trance in front of a man the clip calls Friend. A narrator's clip played on the show, in an episode with the researcher Grant Cameron about the head of the government's UFO programme, describes it: "He sat for several minutes and then appeared in a deep trance with his Adam's apple moving up and down rapidly." The scene matters because it would put an official witness in the room for a contact session.
